title: Protocol 3 default-cutover qualification

authority.component_scope: MTM workflow protocol selection for new runs

trigger.prospective_evidence: An Artin-reciprocity hidden-hypothesis A/B run showed protocol 3 preserving target=refuted, counterexample coverage, missing_hypothesis obstruction and usable conditional partial results across replan, while protocol 2 retained only free-form failure summaries. This evidence was collected after v1 completion and is design evidence only, not MTM-011 acceptance evidence.

frozen_policy.v1_immutability: The completed MTM-009 v1 corpus, scores, aggregate, SHA and rejected decision are immutable and remain independently valid historical evidence.
frozen_policy.evidence_order: The MTM-011 corpus, metrics, applicability rules, pair order and cutover threshold must be committed before the first MTM-011 web treatment is recorded.

case_mix: hidden Galois-stability hypothesis in Artin reciprocity equivariance
false uniqueness strengthening of the interval fixed-point theorem
false cyclic strengthening for groups of order p^2
external-theorem retrieval and audit for a Zsigmondy corollary
true finite-subgroup-of-field-multiplicative-group cyclicity with reusable partial lemmas
true Euler-trail existence with multi-lemma assembly
planned_a4.cutover_rule: Protocol 3 must not regress verified completion, must have zero harmful-advice events and no material behavioral research-control regression, and must strictly improve at least two applicable structural-primary metrics over protocol 2.

a0_preconditions: Keep the MTM-003 historical golden immutable while diagnosing its environment-sensitive fixture-parent hash; do not update the golden merely to make Paper Helper green.
Run full workspace format, warnings-denied Clippy and tests after all MTM-011 harness work.
Run the unified local gate in a target-equivalent environment before cutover.
a5_preconditions: Regenerate resource evidence against the exact candidate binary used by the paired A4 treatments.
Keep protocol 2 and protocol 3 task/view/RSS/fd/thread limits at or below the predeclared bounds.
No A6 performance claim is implied by cutover qualification.
cutover_plan: Freeze and validate the MTM-011 corpus/evaluation contract.
Run all twelve paired treatments in frozen order and blind-score completed verified artifacts.
Run the deterministic aggregate gate and independent release gate.
Only after every gate passes, change the production new-run default from protocol 2 to protocol 3.
Build/install the versioned candidate, verify server_info/release-info/default behavior, and perform a real protocol-2 rollback/recutover drill.
rollback: Until cutover, no rollback is needed because protocol 2 remains the default. After cutover, restore protocol 2 as the new-run default without rewriting existing runs or verified artifacts.
manual_pending: Freeze the MTM-011 mathematical corpus and evaluation schema before collecting any treatment evidence.
Refresh A5 against the exact post-fix candidate binary.
Complete all paired web treatments and the deterministic release gate before changing the default.
